description.value: The Longhorn Saloon is one of Whistler's most iconic après-ski and après-bike bars, situated at the base of Whistler Mountain just steps from the gondolas and operated by the Gibbons Hospitality Group. It features an expansive slopeside patio known for high-energy atmosphere, live music, and weekly themed events. The venue explicitly caters to mountain bikers finishing their day on the mountain alongside skiers and snowboarders.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 95m; rack at 99m.
